feat(mobile): complete template detail print and edit fork flow

Direct image/editable Use downloads and validates the published resource
into the real print preview without creating any personal or account copy.
Editable Edit signs in when needed, stores a code/version-only pending
intent, forks idempotently into the account workspace, and opens the
account-owned copy in Plate. My Templates gains the full status action
matrix with cursor pagination and 409 conflict refresh. Router wires the
templates tab/detail with the shared print controller and adds the account
editor and public edit continuation routes.
